scope: Duke University Chapel as seen on September 1, 2019, including the 210-foot entrance tower, cruciform chapel, attached Duke family memorial chapel and directly attached open cloister.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Duke records a 210-foot tower with a 38-foot square base and the collegiate Gothic design led by Julian Abele.
Duke University Archives documents the historical design, cornerstone in 1930 and opening in 1932.
